Show that: 

- $r_{i1}= - [\delta L_i / \delta \hat y_i] = - \frac{\delta (log (1+e^{\hat y_i})- y_i \hat y_i)}{\delta \hat y_i}$
- Is equal to $-[p_i- y_i]$

Recall that the derivative is (from the previous slides):

- $r_{i1}=-[\frac{e^{\hat y_i}}{1+ e^{\hat y_i}} - y_i]$

Recall that 

- $\hat y_i = \log\frac {p_i}{1-p_i}$
- So $\rightarrow e^{\hat y_i} = \frac{p_i}{1-p_i}$
- $\rightarrow e^{\hat y_i} - e^{\hat y_i}p_i = p_i$
- $\rightarrow e^{\hat y_i} = p_i + e^{\hat y_i}p_i$
- $\rightarrow e^{\hat y_i} = (1 + e^{\hat y_i})p_i$
- $\rightarrow \frac{e^{\hat y_i}}{1 + e^{\hat y_i}} =p_i$

Thus:

- $r_{i1}=-[\frac{e^{\hat y_i}}{1+ e^{\hat y_i}} - y_i]= -[p_i-y_i]$
